name: ModelVariant844_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant844_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (while the ambient light dims, two ribbon trails follow pairs of model parts, then two rounds of sparks, flares and four-petal bursts open around the opposing slot before a spinning beam of light rises from it; once the bursts are done the light comes back); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the trails, sparks, flares and bursts and packs three texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the trail start, 4 once when the first round of bursts starts, 1 once when the second round starts, 2 once the end time has passed after the light recovers and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-861 and 958 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
